text:
Sam Blake (OxfordAero): Hey CS — we're ready to onboard our fine-tuned 13B model (fae-13b-oxd) to Redwood Hosted. Need HSM-backed keys (BYOK), PHI-aware redaction, and a safety/regression eval. Can we get a runbook and ETA?
Maria Chen: Thanks Sam — tagging SE/Infra. Quick Q: expected qps and typical token lengths?
Sam Blake (OxfordAero): Peak ~30 qps, typical responses 64–256 tokens, occasional long docs up to ~2000 tokens. Payloads include structured PHI flags + free text.
Ryan Patel: We can support Hosted + BYOK with HSM KMS. If data residency or stricter isolation is required, Private is also an option. Do you have a preferred region?
Sam Blake (OxfordAero): EU residency required (eu-west-1). Hosted is preferred if BYOK/HSM works. Also need audit logs and retention 1y.
Jenna Ortiz: Security checklist notes: pre-ingest redaction/tokenization, strict ACLs on the S3 eval bucket, HSM key rotation policy, and an audit pipeline. For evals we'll need: latency P95 target, hallucination threshold, and safety filter pass rates.
Maria Chen: Can you share the eval suite and a few representative prompts? We'll queue a staging run once we have them.
Sam Blake (OxfordAero): Uploading now — s3://oxfordaero/onboard/evals/ (1k labeled examples, schema + ground truth). Also uploaded onboarding-runbook.pdf and our HSM contact.
Ryan Patel: I'll kick a staging job. tagging @deploy-bot to start the inference dry-run with fae-13b-oxd at 30qps config.
deploy-bot: Job started: onboard-1785554321-staging — container fae-13b-oxd, env=staging, qps=30, eta ~45m :rocket:
Maria Chen: Noting account health: usage profile looks promising, renewal risk low but latency is a major success metric. If staging meets targets we'll propose Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput. Scheduling enablement 1:1 next week. :calendar:
Sam Blake (OxfordAero): Can you share HSM setup checklist for our infra team? They need exact steps.
Jenna Ortiz: Quick HSM steps: `1) Generate CSR on customer side; 2) Exchange cert with HSM vendor; 3) Upload cert to Console -> Settings -> Keys; 4) Configure key usage policy + rotation schedule; 5) Enable audit export to S3.` I'll DM a detailed doc.
Ryan Patel: I'll follow up with a staging run summary and a cost estimate for Dedicated throughput if you want to lock capacity.
Maria Chen: Opening internal onboarding ticket ONB-3412 and adding the eval link + runbook. Will update thread when staging completes. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
